info.name: IDK OID4VCI + OID4VP E2E
info.description:
End-to-end testing collection for OID4VCI credential issuance and OID4VP credential presentation.

Requires the IDK E2E docker-compose environment running.

Set the `base_url` variable to your EXTERNAL_BASE_URL (e.g., http://192.168.1.100:8080).

item.name: Authorization Server Administration
item.description: Canonical platform-config authorization-server administration and migration-remediation contract. Supply the tenant gateway/config variables and seeded failure fixtures before running this folder.

item.name: 08 List authorization servers and locate the stale discovery fixture

request.description: Lists tenant-owned UUID resources and locates the deliberately seeded stale-discovery fixture used by the activation rejection gate.

exec: const stale = j.items.find((item) => item.deployment === 'EXTERNAL' && item.discovery && item.discovery.freshness === 'STALE');
pm.test('Helm walkthrough does not seed a stale EXTERNAL authorization server', () => pm.expect(stale).to.equal(undefined));
